'''Drufeys''' was a lean and hardworking [[Human/Legends|Human]] male under the employ of [[Binring Biomedical Product]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] Drufeys was employed as a security agent and [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. When [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] devised a trap for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Wraith Squadron]], Drufeys was alerted, along with Doctor [[Edda Gast]], to the squad's movements.
